notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist. Check the link, or go back to isshoni.

pageUnavailable.title: Not in this build yet
pageUnavailable.body: This page is part of isshoni, but the version running on this server doesn't have it yet.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: This page stopped working. Reload to try again.

offline.title: Can't reach the server
offline.body: Check your internet connection. isshoni keeps trying and opens as soon as the server answers.

needsHttps.title: isshoni needs HTTPS
needsHttps.body: Screen sharing, notifications and the app itself only work over a secure connection. Ask your admin to check the TLS setup.

notSetUp.title: This server isn't set up yet
notSetUp.body: Whoever runs the server creates the first admin account. On the server, run:
notSetUp.after: Then open the link it prints.

unsupported.title: This browser can't run isshoni
unsupported.body: isshoni needs WebRTC for video, and this browser doesn't have it or has it turned off. Open this page in a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

fatal.title: Something went wrong
fatal.body: isshoni stopped. Reload the page to start again.

accountDisabled.title: Your account was disabled
accountDisabled.body: An admin turned off your account. Ask them if you think this is a mistake.

tooManyConnections.title: isshoni is open in too many tabs
tooManyConnections.body: Close the isshoni tabs you don't need, then reload this one.

media.title: Can't connect media
media.body: The video connection failed twice in a row. Reload the page to try again.

versionMismatch.title: This page is out of date
versionMismatch.body: The server runs a newer isshoni. Reload to get the matching version.
versionMismatch.serverOlder: The server runs an older isshoni than this page. Ask your admin to update the server.
versionMismatch.stillStale: Reloading didn't help. Ask your admin to check the server.

auto.name: Auto
auto.hint: A good balance for most things

sheet.title: Share your screen
sheet.tip: Recommended: pick a Window and keep Share audio on. Friends hear only that window.
sheet.bestInChrome: Sharing works best in Chrome or Edge.
sheet.desktopApp: Get the desktop app (keeps Discord out of your audio)
sheet.elsewhere: You're already sharing from another tab or device

warning.title: Share all sound on this computer?
warning.body: Friends will hear everything on this computer, including your voice app (Discord, TeamSpeak…), so they'll hear themselves.
warning.why: Screen sharing in a browser can't leave apps out: Discord's own screen share on the web has the same problem. The isshoni desktop app keeps voice apps out of the sound.

note.windowNoAudio: This window's sound isn't shared (needs Windows 11 or macOS 14.2+ and a current Chrome/Edge)
note.tabNoAudio: Tick 'Also share tab audio' to include sound

unavailable.phone: Sharing from phones needs the app (coming later)
